title: Haberler
canDo: Haberleri ve geçmişteki olayları anlatırken olayların sırasını past perfect ile netleştirebilir, past simple, past continuous ve past perfect'i bir arada kullanarak bir hikâye ya da haber aktarabilirim.
grammar: past simple ve past perfect (olay sırası)
by the time / already / before / after / when

liveClass.title: Son dakika!
liveClass.goal: Gruplar, öğretmenin verdiği üç başlıktan birini seçip bir haber programı hazırlar. Bir öğrenci spiker, diğerleri muhabir ve görgü tanığı olur; olayı anlatı zamanlarıyla (was doing, had done, did) aktarırlar. Diğer gruplar Did you hear about...? / Really? What happened next? kalıplarıyla tepki verip soru sorar.

lessons.title: Çoktan olmuştu
lessons.goal: Geçmişteki bir andan daha önce olmuş olayları past perfect ile anlatabilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Past perfect**, geçmişteki bir andan **daha önce** olmuş bir olayı anlatır ("-mıştı").

**Yapı:** **had** + V3 (tüm kişilerde aynı)

| | |
|---|---|
| Olumlu | I / she / they **had left** ('d left) |
| Olumsuz | I **hadn't** seen the film. |
| Soru | **Had** you **eaten** before you came? |

**İki geçmiş olay:**

```
1. olay (daha önce)        2. olay
  had left        ←        got to the station
```

- When I **got** to the station, the train **had left**. (Önce tren gitti, sonra ben vardım.)
- When I **got** to the station, the train **left**. (Ben vardım, sonra tren kalktı.)

Past perfect, **hangi olayın önce olduğunu** netleştirir.

examples.en: When we got home, someone had broken the window.
I hadn't eaten all day, so I was very hungry.
examples.tr: Bütün gün yemek yememiştim, bu yüzden çok açtım.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-mıştı" eki (gitmişti, yemişti) past perfect'e denk gelir. Türkçe konuşanlar "had" i bazen atlar ya da past perfect'i sadece "uzun zaman önce" anlamında kullanır. Past perfect'in amacı süreyi değil, iki geçmiş olay arasındaki sırayı göstermektir.

lessons.title: Hangisi önce oldu?
lessons.goal: by the time, already, before, after ile iki geçmiş olayın sırasını doğru zamanla anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Kayıp köpek eve döndü
discover.body:
A dog called Pamuk has returned home after six weeks.

Pamuk disappeared on 3 March. His owners, the Yıldız family, had taken him to a park outside the city for a picnic. He ran after a rabbit and didn't come back.

The family looked everywhere. They had already put up hundreds of posters when, last Tuesday, they received a phone call. A farmer had found Pamuk in his barn, 40 kilometres away.

"By the time we got to the farm, the farmer's children had given him a bath and a big dinner," said Mrs Yıldız. "He'd lost a bit of weight, but he was happy and healthy."

questions.prompt: Why had the family gone to the park?
questions.explanation: "had taken him to a park... for a picnic"

questions.prompt: What had the farmer's children done before the family arrived?
options: Given Pamuk a bath and dinner
questions.explanation: "had given him a bath and a big dinner"

learn.explanation:
Olaylar **sırasıyla** anlatılıyorsa past simple yeterlidir:

- Pamuk **ran** after a rabbit, and he **didn't come** back.

Sıra **bozulduğunda** (daha önceki bir olaydan bahsederken) past perfect kullanılır:

- Pamuk **disappeared**. The family **had taken** him to a park.

**Sık kullanılan bağlaçlar:**

| Bağlaç | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **by the time** | **By the time** we arrived, they **had eaten**. (Biz vardığımızda çoktan yemişlerdi.) |
| **already** | The thief **had already** left. |
| **before** | She **had** never **flown before** that trip. |
| **after** | **After** he **had finished** work, he went home. |
| **because** | I was tired **because** I **hadn't slept**. |

**before / after** kullanılırsa sıra zaten belli olduğu için past simple de olur:

- After he **finished** work, he went home. ✓

lessons.title: Hikâye zamanları
lessons.goal: Past simple, past continuous ve past perfect'i bir arada kullanarak bir olayı canlı bir şekilde anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Kahraman garson
discover.body:
It was a busy Saturday evening at a small restaurant in Antalya. The waiters were running between the tables and the kitchen was full of noise.

Suddenly, a customer stood up and shouted for help. A man at the next table was holding his throat. He had been fine a minute earlier, but now he couldn't breathe.

A young waiter, Barış Aydın, ran to the table. Luckily, he had learned first aid in a course the year before. He helped the man, and after a few seconds the man started breathing again.

When the ambulance arrived, the man was sitting calmly and drinking water. Everyone in the restaurant was clapping.

questions.prompt: What were the waiters doing when the problem started?
questions.explanation: "The waiters were running between the tables"

questions.prompt: Why did Barış know what to do?
options: He had learned first aid the year before.
He had seen it on TV.
questions.explanation: "he had learned first aid in a course the year before"

learn.explanation:
Bir hikâye anlatırken **üç geçmiş zaman** birlikte kullanılır:

| Zaman | Görevi | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Past continuous** | Arka plan, sahne | The waiters **were running** between the tables. |
| **Past simple** | Ana olaylar, sırasıyla | A customer **stood up** and **shouted**. |
| **Past perfect** | Daha önce olanlar | He **had learned** first aid the year before. |

**Hikâyeyi canlı yapan ifadeler:**

- **Suddenly**, ... / **All of a sudden**, ...
- **Luckily**, ... / **Unfortunately**, ...
- **At first**, ... **Then** ... **In the end**, ...
- **A minute earlier** / **the day before** / **the year before**

**Dikkat:** Past perfect'i **her cümlede** kullanmayın; sadece zaman çizgisinde geriye gittiğinizde kullanın.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede hikâye anlatırken "-yordu" (past continuous), "-dı" (past simple) ve "-mıştı" (past perfect) eklerini kullanırız; İngilizcedeki üç zaman bunlara oldukça iyi denk gelir. "When I arrived, the man was sitting" (oturuyordu) ile "had sat" (oturmuştu) arasındaki farka dikkat edin.

lessons.title: Bugünkü manşetler
lessons.goal: Haber manşetlerini anlayabilir, haber fiilleri ve olay kelimeleriyle kısa haberleri anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Yerel haber bülteni
discover.body:
STORM HITS COAST
A strong storm hit the Black Sea coast last night. Strong winds destroyed several roofs, and some roads are closed. Luckily, everyone survived.

THIEF RETURNS STOLEN BIKE
A thief who had stolen a bike from a student in Eskişehir brought it back two days later. He left a note: "Sorry. My mother told me to bring it back."

FIRE BREAKS OUT IN SHOPPING CENTRE
A fire broke out in a shopping centre in Bursa yesterday afternoon. Staff helped hundreds of people leave the building safely. Firefighters rescued two workers from the roof.

questions.prompt: Why did the thief return the bike?
questions.explanation: "My mother told me to bring it back."

questions.prompt: Where did the firefighters rescue two workers from?

learn.explanation:
**Haber manşetlerinin dili** kısa ve özeldir:

| Manşette | Anlamı |
|---|---|
| **Present simple** = geçmiş olay | STORM **HITS** COAST → A storm **hit** the coast. |
| **to + fiil** = gelecek | PRESIDENT **TO VISIT** JAPAN → The president **will visit** Japan. |
| **a / the** yok | THIEF RETURNS BIKE → **A** thief returned **a** bike. |

**Haber ve olay fiilleri:**

| Fiil | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **hit** (hit) | A storm hit the city. |
| **break out** (broke out) | A fire broke out. |
| **rescue** | Firefighters rescued two people. |
| **escape** | Three prisoners escaped. |
| **arrest** | The police arrested a man. |
| **destroy** | The flood destroyed 50 houses. |
| **survive** | Everyone survived. |

**Haberde yer ve zaman** genellikle cümlenin sonundadır: A fire broke out **in Bursa yesterday afternoon**.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe manşetlerde geçmiş olaylar genellikle geçmiş zamanla verilir ("Fırtına sahili vurdu"), ama İngilizce manşetlerde geçmiş olaylar için present simple neredeyse kuraldır. Haberi okurken ya da anlatırken past simple'a çevirin: STORM HITS COAST → A storm hit the coast.

lessons.goal: Bir haberi arkadaşıma aktarabilir, haberlere doğal tepkiler verebilir ve soru sorarak konuşmayı sürdürebilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Bir haberi açmak:**

- **Did you hear about** ...? / **Have you heard about** ...?
- **Guess what!** / **You'll never believe this!**
- **Apparently**, ... (Söylenene göre ...)
- **I read / saw (online) that** ...

**Tepki vermek:**

| Duygu | İfade |
|---|---|
| Şaşkınlık | **Really?** / **You're joking!** / **No way!** |
| Hayranlık | **That's incredible / amazing!** |
| Üzüntü | **Oh no! That's awful / terrible.** |
| Rahatlama | **Thank goodness!** / **What a relief!** |
| Komik | **That's hilarious!** |

**Konuşmayı sürdürmek:**

- **What happened next?** / **And then what?**
- **How did they ...?** / **Was anyone hurt?**

Hikâyeyi aktarırken **anlatı zamanlarını** kullanın: He **was cooking** when he **found** a ring. The woman **had lost** it.

task.prompt: Yerel bir gazete için kısa bir haber yazın (120–150 kelime). Bir manşetle başlayın, olayı anlatı zamanlarıyla (past continuous, past simple, past perfect) anlatın, bir görgü tanığından alıntı ekleyin ve sonucu belirtin. Gerçek ya da hayali olabilir.
task.modelAnswer:
STUDENT RETURNS LOST WALLET WITH 20,000 LIRA

A university student in Konya returned a lost wallet to its owner yesterday.

Elif Demir, 20, was walking to class on Tuesday morning when she saw a brown wallet on the ground. When she opened it, she found 20,000 lira and an ID card. The owner, a 68-year-old man, had dropped it while he was getting off the bus.

Elif took the wallet to the police station immediately. The police found the owner's phone number, and he came to the station an hour later.

"I had looked everywhere and I was very worried," he said. "This young woman is a hero."

The man wanted to give Elif some of the money, but she said no. "I just did the right thing," she said.

questions.modelAnswer: I'll never forget the day of my sister's wedding. It was a beautiful summer morning and everyone was getting ready at my parents' house. My mother was cooking and my father was looking for his tie. Suddenly, my sister started crying. She had left her wedding dress at the dressmaker's the day before! I jumped into the car and drove across the city. By the time I got to the shop, the dressmaker had already gone home. Luckily, her neighbour had a key, and she opened the shop for me. I got back just in time. In the end, it was a perfect day, and now we laugh about it every year.
